full_prompt_en: A graphic editorial fashion portrait places a woman frontally at the center of a square frame. She wears a huge sculptural brimmed hat whose left side is chalk white and whose right side falls into nearly solid black. The brim curves outward across almost the full width, hiding her eyes and casting a decisive horizontal shadow over the upper face. A narrow black band wraps the crown. Beneath the shadow, her pale lower face and dark red lips become the only small, detailed focal point. A high-neck garment follows the same strict vertical division: luminous white fabric on the left, deep black on the right. The split line runs through the crown, face, neck, and torso, making the body read as two matching yet opposing graphic planes. Behind her, the ground is divided more loosely into vivid dark crimson above and to the right and a large warm off-white wedge rising from the left. The portrait has the polish of studio fashion photography, but its editing reduces form to large clean blocks. Smooth skin and satin-like cloth retain subtle photographic gradients near the chin and shoulders, while the hat's underside becomes a broad matte shadow. Light from the front-left models the white side gently; the dark side remains legible only at its edge and in muted highlights. The palette is exceptionally limited: scarlet, white, charcoal, black, and a small glint of burgundy on the lips. Strong symmetry is disrupted by the exaggerated sweep of the brim and the angled background wedge. The image feels poised and theatrical, using a few oversized shapes and one precise color accent to create a sharp modern fashion statement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅图形化时尚编辑肖像把一名女性正面置于方形画幅中央。她戴着巨大的雕塑性宽檐帽，左半像粉笔一样白，右半落入近乎实黑。帽檐向外弯扫，几乎跨越整个画幅宽度，遮住眼睛，并在上半张脸投下明确水平阴影。一条窄黑带环绕帽冠。阴影下，她苍白的下半脸与深红嘴唇成为唯一细小而精致的焦点。高领衣服沿同一严格竖线对分：左边发亮白布，右边深黑。分割线穿过帽冠、面部、颈部和躯干，让身体读成两块相合却对立的图形平面。她身后，底面较松散地分为上部和右侧的浓深绯红，以及从左侧升起的大块暖灰白楔形。肖像带着影棚时尚摄影的光洁度，编辑处理却把形体缩减为干净的大色块。平滑皮肤和缎面般衣料在下巴、肩部保留微妙摄影渐层，帽底则成宽大哑光暗影。来自左前的光柔和塑造白色半边；深色半边只在边缘和压低的高光中可辨。调色极其有限：猩红、白、炭灰、黑，加上唇上一点酒红亮色。强烈对称被帽檐夸张的横扫和斜向背景楔形打断。画面姿态端定而有戏剧性，用少数巨大的形状和一个精确色彩重点建立锋利的现代时尚表达。
style_prompt_en: Graphic editorial photography organizes the frame into oversized, cleanly bounded planes of crimson, warm white, charcoal, and near-black. A strong vertical division aligns opposing light and dark halves, while one wide curved band sweeps across it to create a shallow horizontal shadow. The palette remains spare, with a tiny saturated burgundy accent providing the focal point amid broad neutral areas. Hard silhouette edges coexist with smooth photographic gradients on rounded surfaces and faint satin sheen along folds. Frontal light, biased slightly to one side, gives pale planes soft volume while leaving dark planes almost flat. The background uses an angled wedge to disturb central symmetry without clutter. Large areas of unmarked color and a disciplined balance of arc, straight seam, and diagonal produce a polished, theatrical visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化编辑摄影把画幅组织成绯红、暖白、炭灰与近黑的巨大清晰边界平面。强竖向分割使相反明暗两半对齐，一道宽阔弧带横扫其上，制造浅而水平的阴影。配色稀少，只用一点饱和酒红在宽广中性色域中提供焦点。硬朗剪影边缘与圆浑表面的平滑摄影渐层、褶皱上的淡缎面光泽并存。略偏单侧的正面光给浅色平面柔和体积，深色平面几乎保持平坦。背景用斜楔打破中央对称，却不添杂乱。大块无痕颜色与弧线、直缝和对角线的严谨平衡形成光洁而戏剧化的视觉节奏。
theme_en: A fashion portrait divided into black and white halves beneath a sweeping hat
theme_zh: 宽檐帽下以黑白两半对分的时尚肖像
name: Patricia Voulgaris
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
